stem: Which message is expressed by both the article and the poem?

options.label: A
options.text: Some activities can be appreciated simply for the fun of them.

options.label: B
options.text: Even if you do not succeed right away, you must keep on trying.

options.label: C
options.text: A great talent is often shared by family members.

options.label: D
options.text: It is important to be a polite and kindhearted winner.
